subject.title: fix(reef): bound legacy state file reads in doctor migration

question: For valid legacy Reef files above the safe read cap, should doctor stream and migrate them, or may it refuse them only with a documented, data-preserving recovery/export path?
rationale: The code can safely cap memory either way, but whether historical persistent state must be migrated automatically or may require operator recovery is a data-retention and upgrade-policy choice.

options.title: Stream oversized legacy state
options.body: Implement bounded streaming parsing/import so doctor preserves and migrates valid history without a whole-file allocation.

options.title: Approve explicit recovery
options.body: Keep the refusal only if doctor offers a documented, data-preserving export or recovery path and proves that path for oversized files.

recommendation.title: Stream oversized legacy state
recommendation.body: Implement bounded streaming parsing/import so doctor preserves and migrates valid history without a whole-file allocation.

likelyOwner.reason: No safely attributable current-main owner could be established from the available review evidence.
